integrity_notes: Exact rational vector-field and Jacobian verification supplements an all-parameter analytic derivation. No independent external scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the exact deterministic balanced-community pure-triangle SIS mean-field equations with 0 <= epsilon < 1, and to existence of a hyperbolic local asymmetric sink for some positive triangle transmission rate. Does not classify nonlinear stability at the critical nonhyperbolic point, basins, all equilibria at a fixed transmission rate, finite stochastic population, pairwise terms, or imbalanced communities.
title: A sharp triadic segregation threshold in two-community contagion
